author: sascha
name: Add work categories with human and agent workflow descriptions
description:
Scope: introduce the work categories ideation, research, concept, design, implementation, debugging and refactoring in the todo app, with clear descriptions and useful behavior for humans and agents.

Define what each category means, its typical deliverable, completion criteria and how its instructions differ. Implement category selection/display and include the relevant description in human and AI briefings. Keep category separate from the existing module/group field so a task can, for example, concern City while being research or debugging. Do not turn a category label into implicit authorization to implement, publish or deploy; preserve explicit planning and approval boundaries.

Inspect current schema, validators, API, UI and process documents. Choose and document a backward-compatible representation and safe migration/default strategy that preserves all existing records, source attribution, groups, statuses and concurrent edits. Keep one source of truth for category definitions rather than divergent human/agent wording. Clarify whether categories describe work type or lifecycle stage; the original idea does not settle single versus multiple selection, default assignment, filtering or transitions.

Acceptance: all seven named categories are available with understandable human/agent descriptions; records save and reload correctly; briefings reflect category intent; existing todos remain valid and editable; documentation explains usage and migration. Use temporary data for validation. Resolve the open representation/interaction choices before implementation and avoid automatic mass classification without a clear rule.
